title: Discovery Upload
description: Sequential binary chunk upload for discovery artifacts (e.g. PCAP traces) framed by config.discovery and state.discovery.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp the upload chunk was generated

family.description: Protocol family associated with the discovery trace upload

generation.description: The discovery scan trigger's generation timestamp

event_no.description: Sequence number for this upload chunk: 0 for start marker, 1..N for data chunks, -(N + 1) for terminal EOF marker

sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the complete unencoded binary payload (included on the terminal negative event_no marker)
